method: Decoded one frame at each slide midpoint with ffmpeg and visually inspected all five full-resolution frames.

frames.review: Title, turbine, pad-mount transformer, and maintenance cart are legible and read as colored objects.
Three material controls and their assigned turbine parts are readable beside the default rendered turbine.
Default, weathered, and high-visibility presets visibly change the turbine palette; high-visibility blades are orange.
Eight kit previews are legible; the corrected vertical-axis model shows three separated rotor blades, central shaft, and radial supports.
Quality, preview, lint, integration, local-page totals, and not-deployed caveat are legible.

result: All five frames reviewed; layout and captions are readable at 1280x720. The clip distinguishes local checks from deployment and physical acceptance.
